categories.name: Lands
categories.counts_when: the card's type line includes Land

categories.name: Ramp
categories.counts_when: it puts extra mana or lands into play beyond the land drop

categories.name: Card advantage
categories.counts_when: it starts as one card and gives you more than one card

categories.name: Targeted disruption
categories.counts_when: one card deals with one opponent's thing: removal, bounce, counter, phasing

categories.name: Mass disruption
categories.counts_when: one card deals with many things: board wipes, mass artifact or enchantment removal, wide taxes, graveyard hate

categories.name: Plan
categories.counts_when: it does what this deck is trying to do
